name: Gou Ibaraki
source:
As the name would suggest, Gou is the (younger) twin brother to Nonoka - much to her dismay.

Although his quirks are constantly a source of embarrassment for his sister (such as, his love of roast beef sandwiches), he is surprisingly dependable when it comes to fulfilling her ambition of performing at the school's graduation ceremony.
